tasks.subject: Task 0: Project scaffold
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An Astro + TypeScript + Tailwind project that builds for Cloudflare Workers, with both Vitest configurations in place.

**Files:**
- `package.json`
- `astro.config.mjs`
- `tsconfig.json`
- `wrangler.jsonc`
- `src/env.d.ts`
- `src/styles/global.css`
- `vitest.config.ts`
- `.gitignore`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] pnpm build produces dist/_worker.js/index.js
- [ ] pnpm astro check reports no type errors
- [ ] Tailwind classes apply on a page
- [ ] node_modules, dist, .astro and .wrangler are git-ignored

**Verify:** `pnpm build && pnpm astro check`

**Steps:** See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-22-food-truck-website.md` → Task 0: Project scaffold

tasks.subject: Task 1: Date helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Time-zone-correct date primitives that every other module depends on, with the Copenhagen rollover pinned by tests.

**Files:**
- `src/lib/datetime.ts`
- `tests/unit/datetime.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] todayInCopenhagen returns the Copenhagen calendar day in both CET and CEST
- [ ] addDays crosses month and year boundaries
- [ ] weekdayIndex returns 0 for Monday through 6 for Sunday
- [ ] formatDanishDate renders a date for display

**Verify:** `pnpm vitest run tests/unit/datetime.test.ts`

**Steps:** See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-22-food-truck-website.md` → Task 1: Date helpers

tasks.subject: Task 2: Schedule resolution
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The pure function that turns the weekly pattern plus exceptions into the seven days shown on the front page.

**Files:**
- `src/lib/types.ts`
- `src/lib/schedule.ts`
- `tests/unit/schedule.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] resolveWeek returns exactly seven entries starting with today
- [ ] An exception replaces the pattern entry entirely
- [ ] A day is closed when the exception says so or the pattern has no location
- [ ] The window crosses month and year boundaries
- [ ] The function performs no I/O and reads no clock

**Verify:** `pnpm vitest run tests/unit/schedule.test.ts`

**Steps:** See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-22-food-truck-website.md` → Task 2: Schedule resolution

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/types.ts", "src/lib/schedule.ts", "tests/unit/schedule.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "pnpm vitest run tests/unit/schedule.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["resolveWeek returns exactly seven entries starting with today", "An exception replaces the pattern entry entirely", "A day is closed when the exception says so or the pattern has no location", "The window crosses month and year boundaries", "The function performs no I/O and reads no clock"]}
```

- [ ] Each test file starts from a clean database

**Verify:** `pnpm test:worker`

**Files:**

- `src/middleware.ts`
- `tests/unit/access.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A correctly signed token with matching issuer and audience yields the email
- [ ] Wrong issuer, wrong audience, expired token or bad signature is rejected
- [ ] A missing header is rejected
- [ ] Middleware returns 403 for /admin on failure and leaves public pages untouched
- [ ] The verifier accepts an injected key set so it is testable offline

**Verify:** `pnpm vitest run tests/unit/access.test.ts`

**Steps:** See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-22-food-truck-website.md` → Task 9: Cloudflare Access verification

tasks.subject: Task 11: Deploy pipeline (no domain required)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove the build-migrate-deploy path against the real Cloudflare account.

**Done:**
- Migrations applied to the remote D1 (`0001_initial.sql`; three tables + seven seeded weekly_stops rows)
- `docs/runbook.md` written; README deploy section updated

**Remaining (owner):** connect the GitHub repo under the Worker's Settings -> Build.
Build command `pnpm build`; deploy command `pnpm wrangler d1 migrations apply chicks_on_wheels --remote && pnpm wrangler deploy`; branch `main`.
The Worker does not exist on the account until that first build runs.

**Note:** `pnpm wrangler deploy` was deliberately NOT run locally - deploys are git-connected.

tasks.description:

**Blocked on:** the `chicksonwheels.dk` transfer.

**Steps:** See the plan -> Task 12. Register/attach the domain, create the Access application, put the team domain and AUD tag in `wrangler.jsonc`, seed the real weekly pattern, replace the placeholder phone and email, and add the Access sections to the runbook.
